entities.summary: Omari Jahi Palmer is an American professional wrestler. He is primarily performing for All Japan Pro Wrestling under the ring name Oddyssey, where he is a former World Tag Team Champion, and is a member of the HAVOC stable alongside Shotaro Ashino and Xyon. He is also known for his time in WWE, where he performed under the ring name Odyssey Jones.
